hints.title: Calculating targetTicks
hints.content: One full wheel rotation covers `Math.PI * wheelDiameter` cm. Divide your target distance by that to get revolutions, then multiply by `TICKS_PER_REV`: `int targetTicks = (int)(TARGET_CM / (Math.PI * WHEEL_DIAMETER_CM) * TICKS_PER_REV);`

hints.title: Order of operations
hints.content: Reset encoders first (`STOP_AND_RESET_ENCODER`), then set the target position, then switch to `RUN_TO_POSITION`. The target is relative to the position at the time of the mode switch.

hints.title: Power must be set after RUN_TO_POSITION
hints.content: Switching to `RUN_TO_POSITION` doesn't start the motor moving — you still have to call `setPower()` with a positive value. Without it, the motor sits idle.

hints.title: The busy loop
hints.content: Use `while (opModeIsActive() && (leftMotor.isBusy() || rightMotor.isBusy()))` to wait. Always include `opModeIsActive()` so the robot responds to a Driver Station stop command.
